cohort: 200 postnatal mothers who delivered normal and healthy babies at Rajendra Institute of Medical Sciences (RIMS), Ranchi, Jharkhand, India between March-May 2017
finding: Early initiation of breastfeeding was found to be only 21.5% among postnatal mothers, and was significantly associated with maternal education, frequent ANC visits, place of residence, and mode of delivery.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with early initiation of breastfeeding.
